An Indian manufacturer looking for a Japanese technology partner

The right partner depends on fit and shared expectations, not only on capability.

The situation

An Indian maker of precision components wants a Japanese partner whose process technology could raise the quality of its products. Several Japanese firms might be suitable, but the company does not know which would be interested, or what each side would expect from the other.

How SetuHashi could help

Search for and qualify potential Japanese partners, bring the parties together to discuss contributions, responsibilities and working practices, and support introductions, visits and early work together.

What the assignment could produce

A qualified shortlist, a shared statement of expectations and, if both sides proceed, a documented basis for a commercial agreement.

The intended value

A partnership both sides enter with a clear understanding of what each will contribute and expect.

Related services

  • Find and develop suitable partnerships
  • Develop workable agreements
